name: Build GitHub Pages artifact

# PR #1188 (R1188-U9): no job may run past 30 minutes. The release workflow's
# one Pages job used to build the web bundle, run `cargo doc` for the
# /docs/api reference (issue #479) on a cold cargo cache AND wait in the GitHub
# Pages deployment queue (PR #965), which needed a 35-minute cap. The build
# half lives here, under its own cap; `deploy-pages` in release.yml only
# deploys the `github-pages` artifact this job uploads to the calling run.
#
# This lives in its own reusable workflow rather than as a job in release.yml
# so that file, which sits against the 1500-line warning band that issue #999
# and issue #1012 both pin, does not have to pay for it.

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      sha:
        description: The commit to build and stamp; the release child commit when auto-release creates one.
        required: true
        type: string
    outputs:
      pages_sha:
        description: The commit the artifact was built from and stamped with.
        value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.pages_sha }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build GitHub Pages artifact
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    outputs:
      pages_sha: ${{ steps.pages_ref.outputs.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Select Pages deployment ref
        id: pages_ref
        env:
          PAGES_DEPLOY_SHA: ${{ inputs.sha }}
        run: |
          if [[ ! "$PAGES_DEPLOY_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Could not resolve Pages deployment SHA"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "sha=${PAGES_DEPLOY_SHA}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Pages deployment SHA: ${PAGES_DEPLOY_SHA}"
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
      - name: Verify trusted release branch matches the requested artifact commit
        env:
          PAGES_DEPLOY_SHA: ${{ steps.pages_ref.outputs.sha }}
        run: |
          # The release caller restricts this build to main. An input may
          # select an artifact only when it equals the trusted branch checkout.
          # Reject concurrent branch movement instead of building another commit.
          if [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" != "$PAGES_DEPLOY_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::error::Pages artifact SHA does not match the trusted release branch"
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version-file: .bun-version
      - name: Install web bundle dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build web vendor bundle
        run: bun run build:web
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Free up runner disk space
        run: bash scripts/free-runner-disk.sh
      - uses: ./.github/actions/cache-cargo-registry
        with:
          prefix: docs-
      - name: Generate Rust API docs (cargo doc --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml)
        env:
          RUSTDOCFLAGS: -D warnings
        run: bash scripts/build-rust-api-docs.sh
      - name: Sync data/seed into js/seed (deployment mirror)
        run: scripts/sync-seed.sh
      - name: Install rust-script
        run: bash scripts/install-rust-script.sh
      - name: Read formal-ai version from Cargo.toml
        id: formal_ai_version
        run: rust-script scripts/get-version.rs
      - name: Stamp GitHub Pages artifact
        run: scripts/stamp-pages-artifact.sh js "${{ steps.pages_ref.outputs.sha }}" "${{ steps.pages_ref.outputs.sha }}" "${{ steps.formal_ai_version.outputs.version }}"
      - name: Copy Rust API docs into the Pages artifact (/docs/api)
        run: |
          mkdir -p js/docs/api
          cp -R target/doc/. js/docs/api/
      - name: Upload GitHub Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5
        with:
          path: js
          include-hidden-files: true
